description: Holds every currency future (euro, yen, pound, Australian, Canadian and New Zealand dollars, Swiss franc, Mexican peso, Brazilian real) whose 12-month return is positive, equally weighted, monthly. Falsified if trend in currencies has no edge after carry is included. Backtested on FinzData currency futures: front-month contract rolled on the FinzData roll calendar as an excess-return index, so the interest-rate differential (carry) is in the return; costs as stated, re-run free on full history.
title: Currency futures trend · 12-month time-series momentum · 9 currencies (after Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen 2012)
